title: Food and Beverage Executive
summary: Supervises food and beverage service in a hotel's restaurants, bars, in-room dining and banquets. Sits in the F&B service team under the outlet or banquet manager and leads stewards and captains on each shift.
dailyDuties: Supervise service in the restaurant, bar and in-room dining
Set up and run banquets from the banquet event order
Brief the team on menu changes, allergens and upselling
Prepare weekly duty rosters for stewards and captains
Check hygiene and FSSAI compliance in service areas
Close outlet sales and billing in the POS

skills.expectation: Supervise restaurant, bar and in-room dining service to brand standards
Read banquet event orders and run set-up and service for functions
Know the menu, allergens and beverage pairings and brief the team on them
Run outlet billing and day-end closing in a POS such as Micros
Keep service areas compliant with FSSAI hygiene and HACCP practices
Drive upselling of beverages, specials and desserts to meet outlet revenue
Prepare duty rosters and train stewards and captains on service steps
Handle guest feedback at the table and fix service complaints
Lead a shift team of associates and captains
Handle difficult guest situations before they reach the manager
Post room charges for in-house guests through the PMS interface
Track covers, sales and inventory in Excel
Run short on-the-job training sessions for new associates
